comment: Every tests/runtime/*.py and tests/frontend/*.py file must be listed here (tools/dev/run_runtime_tests.py fails on an unlisted one). 'ci' files run on a Windows runner with requirements-ci.txt; the others are skipped with their reason. Measured 23 October 2026 on Windows with CPython 3.12.

skipped.runtime/test_general_settings.py: needs-engine: imports the engine's torch-based modules
skipped.runtime/test_system_settings.py: needs-engine: takes --engine <extracted engine.zip>, needs torch and PyYAML
skipped.runtime/test_model_management.py: needs-runtime: 13 of 14 tests pass on a runner; one needs the real private-runtime layout (.venv and engine/backend/core/contained_subprocess.py)
skipped.runtime/test_windows_runtime_paths.py: needs-runtime: needs the private runtime .venv with the mcp package
skipped.runtime/bootstrap_docopt_regression.py: manual: builds docopt on Windows with explicit arguments, never installs the runtime
skipped.runtime/license_onboarding_ui_check.py: manual: browser acceptance, needs Playwright/Chromium and a built dist
skipped.frontend/speech_settings_backend_check.p: manual: reads a path outside the repository that this checkout does not have
skipped.frontend/audit_upstream.py: helper: the upstream audit module that test_audit_upstream.py loads; not a test
skipped.runtime/test_audiobook_streaming.py: needs-ffmpeg: 2 of 5 tests need a real ffmpeg, which the GitHub Windows runner does not have (found on the first runner run)
